name: Tax1099
summary: Per-form e-filing of 1099s, W-2s and related forms, cheaper per form at high volume, with a subscription for frequent filers. TIN matching, W-9 requests, state filing and corrections can each carry their own charge, so tally the add-ons.
best_for: businesses and accountants who need to e-file 1099s, W-2s and related forms accurately and cheaply, especially seasonal or higher-volume filers
skip_if: you only file one or two forms a year (the IRS's own free options may suffice) or you want full bookkeeping rather than just the filing step
honest_knock: Per-form pricing is genuinely cheap for a handful of 1099s, but it's metered: TIN matching, W-9 requests, state filing and corrections can each carry their own charge. A business filing across many recipients and states should tally the add-ons, not just the headline per-form rate. It's a filing tool, not a bookkeeping system; it assumes your payee data is already clean.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (read 2026-09-08 and re-read 2026-10-01 on tax1099.com/tax-1099-efile-pricing) Filing is graduated volume pricing, not a flat rate that falls: each band is billed at its own rate and the bill is the sum across bands. The Tiered Pricing Charts on the page, with the form-type selector on IRS eFile 1099, 1098, 1095, W-2, W-2C, W-2G, list the first 20 forms at $2.99 each, forms 21-150 at $2.59, 151-250 at $1.99, 251-500 at $1.42 and 501-1,000 at $0.72, with 1,000+ on request. On those bands 30 forms come to $85.70 and 600 forms to $1,022.50, about $1.70 a form. The worked 600-form example higher up the same page uses rates the chart does not show (130 at $2.30, 350 at $1.31) and prints its last line, 100 forms at $0.72, as $68.00; it no longer prints a total. Three eFiling plans: Essential is free, Teams (formerly eFile Plus) is $249 a year and adds multi-user access and 250 free TIN matches, and Scale (formerly Enterprise) is $349 a year and adds workflow, user and action management, API access and Notice Management (otherwise $199 a unit). TIN matching is not free on Essential: real-time is $1.00 a unit, within 24 hours $0.37, bulk $150 per 10,000 records — free on first use up to 10,000 records under one payer for Scale customers only. Other add-ons: eDelivery $0.25 a unit, print and mail $1.90 a form (plus a $1 rush fee in the last five days of the season through 2 February), foreign mail $4.99 a form, state reconciliation $4.99 a payer, and W-9/W-8 requests at $1.00 for one, $7.00 for 25, $45.00 for 200 and $95.00 for 1,000.
